title: Flexible Doubly Robust Proximal Causal Inference for Censored Outcomes
abstract: arXiv:2610.20893v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Estimating causal effects on right-censored time-to-event outcomes is challenging under unmeasured confounding. Proximal causal inference addresses unmeasured confounding through proxy variables, but existing proximal survival methods rely largely on restrictive parametric bridge models. We introduce Proximal Survival Bridge learning (PSB), a flexible doubly robust proximal framework for censored outcomes. Building on existing proximal identification of treatment-specific survival curves, the framework yields outcome-bridge (OB), treatment-bridge (TB), and doubly robust (DR) estimators, with two flexible bridge learners: PSB-K, a kernel estimator with a low-rank time decomposition, and PSB-N, a neural estimator trained by a projected maximum-moment-restriction loss. translated_title: 针对删失结果的灵活双重稳健邻近因果推断
translated_abstract: 在存在未测量混杂因素的情况下，估计右删失生存时间结果的因果效应具有挑战性。邻近因果推断通过代理变量来解决未测量混杂问题，但现有的邻近生存方法主要依赖于限制性较强的参数化桥梁模型。我们提出了邻近生存桥梁学习，这是一个针对删失结果的灵活双重稳健邻近因果推断框架。基于现有的治疗特异性生存曲线的邻近识别方法，该框架给出了结果桥梁（OB）、治疗桥梁（TB）和双重稳健（DR）估计器，并提供了两种灵活的桥梁学习器：PSB-K，一种具有低秩时间分解的核估计器；以及PSB-N，一种通过投影最大矩约束损失训练的神经估计器。与现有的针对标量结果的灵活邻近学习器不同，PSB能够直接处理删失数据和生存曲线目标。在标准结构方程模型基准上，……
tldr: 该论文提出了邻近生存桥梁学习（PSB），一个针对删失结果的灵活双重稳健邻近因果推断框架，通过核估计器（PSB-K）和神经估计器（PSB-N）两种灵活桥梁学习器直接处理删失数据和生存曲线目标，突破了现有方法依赖限制性参数化桥梁模型的局限。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Proximal Survival Bridge learning (PSB), a flexible doubly robust proximal causal inference framework for censored outcomes that directly handles censoring and survival-curve targets through two flexible bridge learners—a kernel estimator with low-rank time decomposition and a neural estimator—overcoming the restrictive parametric bridge model assumptions of existing proximal survival methods.
